title: Khoon Ronda Wain Ponda
body:
Khoon ronda
Har mor te puttar Hussain da mangda, burke mavande
<<DIVIDER>>
Pathran dhiyan barishan, har mor te hondiyan
Zahra dhiyan jaiyyan rondiyan
Kufe vich badal de vekhe le Abid
Matlab cha vaan de
<<DIVIDER>>
Sada chacha jis tarha, si baazu babay da
Seh baszu veeran tu mera,
menu Akabar kaun Abbas de vangu,
Veer salaam vande
<<DIVIDER>>
Oh yasrab shehr si, veeraan da marn si
Aye shaam hay jaanda nahi koi
Kis haal ch safar day aai hay Zainab
Naal bhirawan de
<<DIVIDER>>
Rakhiyan ne izzatan, Eee saiii bastiya
O shehr si kalmago wan day
Jinhe roke shehr guzaar nay Aabid
Shaam di rawaan day
